as_told.title: NASA occult rituals and Launch Pad 33 (Dark Mission)

plain: Some people say the US space agency NASA is full of hidden symbols. Lue Elizondo, the subject of a documentary episode on Jesse Michels' podcast, says on that episode that everything is Masonic. He means it comes from the Freemasons, an old fraternal society with its own symbols. He points to Launchpad 33 as an example and says the Apollo moon missions were all named after signs of the zodiac. Michels, the host, raises the idea again on a later episode. He links it to a book called Dark Mission by Richard Hoagland and to claims of cult rituals inside the space programme, again mentioning Launchpad 33. They raise it because, if true, it would mean the space programme carries a secret symbolic or ritual side that the public is not told about.
